entries.title: III John 1:1
segments: ¶The elder to the beloved Gaius, whom I love in truth.

entries.title: III John 1:2
segments: Beloved, I desire that in all things thou shouldest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospers.

entries.title: III John 1:3
segments: ¶For I rejoiced exceedingly when [the] brethren came and bore testimony to thy [holding fast the] truth, even as *thou* walkest in truth.

entries.title: III John 1:4
segments: I have no greater joy than these things that I hear of my children walking in the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:5
segments: Beloved, thou doest faithfully [in] whatever thou mayest have wrought towards the brethren and that strangers,

entries.title: III John 1:6
segments: (who have witnessed of thy love before [the] assembly,) in setting forward whom on their journey worthily of God, thou wilt do well;

entries.title: III John 1:7
segments: for for the name have they gone forth, taking nothing of those of the nations.

entries.title: III John 1:8
segments: *We* therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow-workers with the truth.

entries.title: III John 1:9
segments: ¶I wrote something to the assembly; but Diotrephes, who loves to have the first place among them, receives us not.

entries.title: III John 1:10
segments: For this reason, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he does, babbling against us with wicked words; and not content with these, neither does he himself receive the brethren; and those who would he prevents, and casts [them] out of the assembly.

entries.title: III John 1:11
segments: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. He that does good is of God. He that does evil has not seen God.

entries.title: III John 1:12
segments: ¶Demetrius has witness borne to him by all, and by the truth itself; and *we* also bear witness, and thou knowest that our witness is true.

entries.title: III John 1:13
segments: I had many things to write to thee, but I will not with ink and pen write to thee;

entries.title: III John 1:14
segments: but I hope soon to see thee, and we will speak mouth to mouth. Peace [be] to thee. The friends greet thee. Greet the friends by name.
